title: DFRobot SEN0610
notes: Remote 4-wire PH2.0 cable. + power, - ground, D/T is sensor TX in UART mode, C/R is sensor RX. Illustration port order is schematic, not a connector pin-number claim. Set mode switch to UART. Supply 3.3V/5V, UART 9600 baud. Public information checked does not specify UART VOH/VOL or RX VIH.
